svg.title: Asphalt paver — Malbiksútlagnarvél
svg.desc: An asphalt paving machine has a wide front receiving hopper and a low trailing screed behind its crawler chassis.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-asphalt-paver","label_en":"Asphalt paver","label_is":"Malbiksútlagnarvél","section":"01","category_en":"Earthmoving and demolition machinery","category_is":"Jarðvinnslu- og niðurrifsvélar","batch":1,"tags":["roadwork","paving"],"description":"An asphalt paving machine has a wide front receiving hopper and a low trailing screed behind its crawler chassis.","design_note":"The forward hopper and trailing flat screed identify the material placing process, without a milling conveyor.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
